focus.name: interaction-spawn-type8b-presentation-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the four Type-0x8B presentation-response handlers to stable creation identities while retaining selector-qualified historical names.

gates: 0x00FFF57F controls the optional prepared audio command 0x32
contracts: Selectors F5-F8 share the Type-0x8B presentation-response template, backward-slot helper, presentation gates, palette resource 0x001292F2, and optional audio path.
The exact static distinction between variants is the installed AnimationVM root: 0x00124A2E, 0x00124A6C, 0x00124AAA, and 0x00124AE0 respectively.
evidence: Exact handler bodies and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
Per-selector animation-root writes and common palette/audio path
limitations: The names identify the shared Type-0x8B presentation creation family, not user-facing object or scene roles.
The upstream lifecycle of the presentation and audio gates remains unresolved.
